answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. This works because the originality bar tightens as more low-quality answers appear, raising the per-alias cost of a coordinated fake campaign. This design turns the attacker's greatest weapon — scale — into its weakest point, because scale is exactly what becomes unaffordable to maintain. Consider a shale as the anchor of the cost.
